page.overview:
Who is Adeline?

Slade revealed that he had assassinated King Maxwell, and also accidentally killed Lady Nora, the wife of the court magus Viktor. Enraged by Nora's death, Viktor cursed the land with an endless Allwinter and even colour itself vanished. Adeline and Slade managed to escape Gyllenhjem, but on the way their sons were caught in the spell and were transformed into Draugr. Adeline blamed Slade for their deaths and all the other suffering the Allwinter had caused. She left him and cut out his right eye.

With the king's death the Old Kingdom was torn apart by warlords known as Jarls, each trying to carve out their own private kingdom in the ashes. Adeline searched the land for the next two decades looking for a way to break the curse. For a time she joined up with Slade's old mercenary partner William Wintergreen, who was tunnelling under the impenetrable Everstorm around Gyllenhjem to reach Viktor and kill him. She grew frustrated with their slow progress, and was unable to forgive Wintergreen for helping Slade kill Maxwell, and so eventually moved on.

Many years later, Adeline discovered Alec, and found that he not only possessed colour, he was able to temporarily break the spell of the Allwinter and temporarily restore colour to anything he touched. Alec received dreams from The Green, the source of his power, which told him he must get to the Old Kingdom's abandoned capital Gyllhenhjem to save the world and end the Allwinter. Adeline believed in Alec's dreams and gathered a small group of followers for the long and perilous journey. As they were preparing to head out, they were attacked by a band of warriors sent by Vandal Savage to capture Alec, including Slade and the ice witch Killer Frost. They killed all of the others, and Adeline was wounded by Frost, but when Slade realised Adeline was there, he turned on the others and drove them off. Slade pulled off Alec's cloak, wanting to see why Savage wanted him, and saw that he had colour.

Slade pulled Frosts' ice spear out of Adeline and she passed out from the pain. She woke up in an Inn, with her injuries sewn up, and Slade and Alec sleeping nearby. She tried to quietly wake Alec up and slip away, but Slade woke too. He asked Adeline who Alec was, and why he could temporarily break the spell of the Allwinter, but she told him it was none of his concern and they started arguing about him working for Savage. The noise woke Alec up and Adeline told him it was time to leave. Alec revealed where they were going and Slade offered to go with them as it was a long journey through dangerous terrain. Adeline refused, saying she would never trust him with a child after what he did to their sons.
